# Assessments

The course is Pass/Fail. There are three requirements.

| Requirement | What it means |
|---|---|
| Weekly attendance | Be in the room each week. Absence policy TBD. |
| Peer feedback | Give and receive structured feedback with the other leaders during the roundtable. |
| AI proficiency | Demonstrate working proficiency with AI tools. Bar and evidence TBD. |

Because student employees are paid for their leadership work, class sessions and
class-specific assignments are not billable hours. Keep the two separate on your timesheet.
